attributes.title: set_view_custom_property
attributes.description: Changes one entry in a Perspective view's top-level 'custom' object and reloads the project so running sessions pick it up. This is the only tool that WRITES to a project resource, so it is two-phase: call it with confirm=false to see the exact before/after and prove the guard holds, then with confirm=true to apply. expected_current_value is mandatory -- you must state the value you believe you are replacing, read from get_view_json. If the guard fails the write is refused; re-read the resource rather than retrying, because it means the ticket is stale or the fix is already in.

parameters.name: view_path
parameters.description: The Designer view path, e.g. 'Exchange/Report Issue Agent/Line Overview'.

parameters.name: property_name
parameters.description: Key inside the view's 'custom' object, e.g. 'torqueTagName'. The property must already exist.

parameters.name: new_value
parameters.description: The corrected value to write, e.g. 'MotorTorque'.

parameters.name: expected_current_value
parameters.description: The value you believe the property holds right now, e.g. 'MotorTorqe'. Read it with get_view_json first. The write is refused if it does not match.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: false (default) is a dry run returning the before/after diff. true applies the change and reloads the project.
